authorization.scope: Complete only V3 Milestone 1: contract, Reference-Book-to-field traceability catalog, metadata-only coverage audit, comprehensive case-matrix schema, and V3 state file.
authorization.verbatim: Create Gold Session Behaviour and Conditional Bias Discovery Contract V3. Preserve all prior results and rejections. Use 2021-08-01 through 2024-12-31 for development, treat 2025 as an exposed historical forward test, and keep 2026 values locked as the independent year-to-date holdout followed by prospective tracking. Permit descriptive neutral session-path measurements but no execution optimization. Complete only the contract, Reference-Book-to-field traceability catalog, metadata-only coverage audit, comprehensive case-matrix schema, and V3 state file. Do not inspect 2025 or 2026 values, calculate relationships, or begin candidate discovery. Stop after Milestone 1.

case_matrix_policy.decision_state_cutoff: No fact may enter decision_state unless available_at is less than or equal to decision_at.
case_matrix_policy.grain: One immutable row per session_code and session_date.
case_matrix_policy.institutional_motive_policy: Institutional motive is never OBSERVED unless a licensed source directly states it; price/open-interest and similar interpretations are INFERRED.
case_matrix_policy.missing_data_policy: UNKNOWN; never zero, neutral confirmation, no-event, or safe.
case_matrix_policy.outcome_separation: subsequent_behaviour is decision_eligible=false and cannot be joined to decision_state during Milestone 1.

data_policy.book_role: Primary business vocabulary, market-logic, epistemic, point-in-time, and explanation specification; not a predetermined empirical answer.

allowed: fixed-clock signed price displacement from a neutral reference
maximum upward displacement from the neutral reference
maximum downward displacement from the neutral reference
timestamps and ordering of session high and low
level touch, breach, acceptance, rejection, failed-break, and close-location facts
session path completeness and data-quality facts

neutral_reference.description: The open of the first complete observed XAUUSD one-minute bar whose open_time is 08:01 local. It is an outcome coordinate, not an executable entry or assumed fill.

not_allowed: position sizing, leverage, or account-return scaling
descriptive_measurement_policy.purpose: Describe what gold did after the decision clock without presuming a long, short, entry, exit, or profitable execution.

milestones.scope: Materialize point-in-time decision state and neutral subsequent behaviour for 2021-08-01 through 2024-12-31 only.
Describe London and New York paths, level interactions, and calendar stability without explanatory relationship testing.
Freeze an eligible feature registry and then test simple point-in-time conditional-bias relationships on development data only.
Apply chronology-aware stability and multiplicity controls; freeze zero to two candidates per session before forward evaluation.
Evaluate frozen candidates unchanged on exposed 2025, locked 2026 YTD, and prospective 2026 segments, reported separately.
Append sealed live decisions before outcomes and report prospective evidence without repair.
Only after a conditional-bias candidate earns independent or prospective evidence; requires new explicit authorization.

operating_protocol.claim_evidence_requirement: Every empirical claim must cite an immutable artifact hash, case count, interval, and measurement definition.

rejected_rule_policy.LONDON_ZN_4H_POSTHOC_V0_1: Rejected on calendar-2025 forward data; cannot be repaired, inverted, filtered, thresholded, renamed, or presented as an active candidate.
rejected_rule_policy.UNIVERSAL_ZN_4H_SIGN_V0_1: Rejected in chronological validation; cannot be repaired, inverted, filtered, thresholded, renamed, or presented as an active candidate.
rejected_rule_policy.zn_future_role: ZN may remain a descriptive rates-context field. Any future use must arise from a separately preregistered, genuinely different hypothesis and cannot claim continuity with either rejected rule.

research_objective.primary_question: Which point-in-time conditions, if any, provide a stable and explainable conditional bias for the direction and path of gold during London and New York sessions?
sequence: describe the behaviour without explanatory tests
discover simple conditional relationships on development only
consider execution only under a separate contract

exposed_historical_forward_test.label: EXPOSED_2025_FORWARD_TEST
exposed_historical_forward_test.reason_exposed: Calendar 2025 was opened once under V2 and used to reject LONDON_ZN_4H_POSTHOC_V0_1.
exposed_historical_forward_test.v3_use: Evaluate only rules frozen without 2025; report separately as historical forward evidence with no independent-validation claim.

prospective_2026.label: PROSPECTIVE_AFTER_FREEZE
prospective_2026.prospective_start_rule: The first complete eligible session strictly after the immutable V3 shortlist freeze timestamp; never retroactively earlier than 2026-07-30.

allowed: metadata-only source coverage and timestamp-completeness audit
prohibited: candidate generation, ranking, selection, or retuning
